tutorial.title: Building with the Box Model
tutorial.descriptionContent: Learn how to style webpages with paddings and margins.

lessons.title: Box model
lessons.interactiveContent: Elements on a webpage are rectangular boxes with four layers: content, paddings, borders, and margins.

lessons.title: Using padding
lessons.interactiveContent: Paddings generate space between the content and the border of an element.

lessons.title: Padding
lessons.interactiveContent:
To change the paddings on all four sides of an element, we use the padding property.

Make sure to pick padding.
lessons.hardModeContent:
To change the paddings on all four sides of an element, we use the padding property.

Give the paragraph 50px of space between its text and its border.

Make sure to pick padding, followed by 50px.

lessons.title: Padding
lessons.interactiveContent:
To change the padding on the left side of an element, we use the padding-left property.

Make sure to pick padding-left.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Add 200px of padding to only the left side of the leftWing paragraph.

Make sure to pick padding-left, followed by 200px.

lessons.title: Padding
lessons.interactiveContent:
To change the padding on the right side of an element, we use the padding-right property.

Make sure to type padding-right.

lessons.title: Padding
lessons.interactiveContent:
To change the padding at the top of an element, we use the padding-top property.

Make sure to pick padding, followed by -, and finally top.
lessons.hardModeContent:
To change the padding at the top of an element, we use the padding-top property. Give the floating objects 20px of padding at the top.

Make sure to pick padding, followed by -, top, and finally 20px.

lessons.title: Padding
lessons.interactiveContent:
To change the padding at the bottom of an element, we use the padding-bottom property.

Make sure to pick padding-bottom.
lessons.hardModeContent:
You use padding-bottom to change the padding at the bottom of an element.

Give the floating objects 60px of padding at the bottom.

Make sure to pick padding-bottom, followed by 60px.

lessons.title: Text align
lessons.interactiveContent:
To change the alignment of the content, we use the text-align property.

Make sure to pick text-align.
lessons.hardModeContent:
You use text-align to align content. Set it to center to center the heading text.

Make sure to pick text-align, followed by center.

lessons.title: Text align
lessons.interactiveContent:
To center-align content, we set the text-align property to center.

Make sure to pick center.
lessons.hardModeContent:
To center-align content, we set the text-align property to center.

The property is in place. Complete its value so the heading's content is centered.

Make sure to pick center.

lessons.title: Question 1
lessons.interactiveContent:
What are paddings?

The space between the content and the border of an elementThe border of an element

The space between the content and the border of an element.
lessons.hardModeContent:
A paragraph has text, padding, and a border. Which space is the padding?

The space between the content and the border of an elementThe space outside the border of an elementThe space occupied by the content of an element

The space between the content and the border of an element.

lessons.title: Question 2
lessons.interactiveContent:
What's the padding-left property for?

It adds space on the left side of an elementIt adds space at the top of an element

It adds space on the left side of an element.
lessons.hardModeContent:
A rule uses padding-left: 30px;. What changes?

It adds space on the left side of an elementIt adds the same space on every side of an elementIt adds space outside the left side of an element

It adds space on the left side of an element.

lessons.title: Question 3
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which of these changes the padding at the top of an element?

padding-toppadding-bottom

Make sure to pick padding-top.
lessons.hardModeContent:
You want only the top padding of an element to change. Which property should you use?

padding-toppadding-bottommargin-top

Make sure to pick padding-top.

lessons.title: Question 4
lessons.interactiveContent:
What's the text-align property for?

It changes the alignment of the content of an elementIt changes the padding at the top and bottom of an element

It changes the alignment of the content of an element.
lessons.hardModeContent:
A heading's text should appear centered inside the heading. What does text-align change?

It changes the alignment of the content of an elementIt changes the padding at the top and bottom of an elementIt moves the entire element to a new position

It changes the alignment of the content of an element.

lessons.title: Example 1
lessons.interactiveContent:
Set the padding property to 30px.

Make sure to pick padding, followed by :, and finally 30px.
lessons.hardModeContent:
You use padding to change the padding on all four sides.

Give the image 30px of padding while keeping its border.

Make sure to pick img, followed by padding, :, and finally 30px.

lessons.title: Example 2
lessons.interactiveContent:
Change the padding on the left side of all h1 elements.

Make sure to pick padding-left, followed by :, and finally 50px.
lessons.hardModeContent:
You use padding-left to change only the left padding.

Give all h1 elements 50px of left padding. Leave the other sides unchanged.

Make sure to pick h1, followed by padding-left, :, and finally 50px.

lessons.title: Example 3
lessons.interactiveContent:
Change the padding at the top of all h1 elements by typing padding-top.

Make sure to type padding-top.

lessons.title: Example 4
lessons.interactiveContent:
Align the content of elements of class center by typing text-align: center;.

Make sure to type text-align: center;.

lessons.title: Margin
lessons.interactiveContent: Margins generate space around an element, outside of any paddings and borders.

lessons.title: Margin property
lessons.interactiveContent:
To change the margins on all four sides of an element, we use the margin property.

Make sure to pick margin.
lessons.hardModeContent:
To change the margins on all four sides of an element, we use the margin property. Move the image 30px away from the elements around it.

Make sure to pick margin, followed by 30px.

lessons.title: Top margin
lessons.interactiveContent:
To change the margin at the top of an element, we use the margin-top property.

Make sure to pick margin-top.
lessons.hardModeContent:
You use margin-top to change the top margin of an element.

Set only the top margin of each image to 20px. Leave the other margins unchanged.

Make sure to pick margin-top, followed by 20px.

lessons.title: Bottom margin
lessons.interactiveContent:
To change the margin at the bottom of an element, we use the margin-bottom property.

Make sure to pick margin-bottom.
lessons.hardModeContent:
You use margin-bottom to change the bottom margin of an element.

Set only the bottom margin of each image to 100px. Leave the other margins unchanged.

Make sure to pick margin-bottom, followed by 100px.

lessons.title: Left
lessons.interactiveContent:
To change the margin on the left side of an element, we use the margin-left properties.

Make sure to pick margin-left.
lessons.hardModeContent:
You use margin-left to change the left margin of an element.

Set only the left margin of each image to 20px. Leave the other margins unchanged.

Make sure to pick margin-left, followed by 20px.

lessons.title: Right
lessons.interactiveContent:
To change the margin on the right side of an element, we use the margin-right property.

Make sure to pick margin-right.
lessons.hardModeContent:
You use margin-right to change the right margin of an element.

Set only the right margin of each image to 20px. Leave the other margins unchanged.

Make sure to pick margin-right, followed by 20px.

lessons.title: Padding and margin
lessons.interactiveContent:
Although they both add spacing around them, margins and paddings are different.

The padding adds space between the content and the border, while the margin adds space between the border and other elements.

lessons.title: Question 1
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which properties does this img element have?

A padding, a border, and a marginA background color

A padding, a border, and a margin.
lessons.hardModeContent:
In the rendered image preview, which set of box-model properties is visibly applied to the img element?

A padding, a border, and a marginA background colorOnly a border

A padding, a border, and a margin.

lessons.title: Question 2
lessons.interactiveContent:
What are margins?

The space around an element, outside of any paddings and bordersThe space between the content and the border of an element

The space around an element, outside of any paddings and borders.
lessons.hardModeContent:
An element has content, padding, a border, and margin. Which part is the margin?

The space around an element, outside of any paddings and bordersThe space between the content and the border of an elementThe thickness of the line drawn around an element

The space around an element, outside of any paddings and borders.

lessons.title: Question 3
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which of these changes the margins on all four sides of an element?

marginmargin-top

Make sure to pick margin.
lessons.hardModeContent:
You want the same outside space on every side of an element. Which property should you use?

marginmargin-toppadding

Make sure to pick margin.

lessons.title: Question 4
lessons.interactiveContent:
What's the difference between paddings and margins?

Paddings are inside while margins are outside of any bordersPaddings are outside while margins are inside of any borders

Paddings are inside while margins are outside of any borders.
lessons.hardModeContent:
A card needs room between its text and border, plus room outside its border. Which statement is true?

Paddings are inside while margins are outside of any bordersPaddings are outside while margins are inside of any bordersPaddings and margins are both outside of any borders

Paddings are inside while margins are outside of any borders.

lessons.title: Example 1
lessons.interactiveContent:
Set the margin property to 50px.

Make sure to pick margin, followed by :, and finally 50px.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Give the paragraph 50px of outside space on every side.

Make sure to pick p, followed by margin, :, and finally 50px.

lessons.title: Example 2
lessons.interactiveContent:
Set the margin on the right side of all img elements.

Make sure to pick margin-right, followed by :, and finally 10px.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Add 10px of outside space to the right of every img element.

A valid page closes body before html; the published HTML block omits that closing tag.

Make sure to pick margin-right, followed by :, and finally 10px.

lessons.title: Example 3
lessons.interactiveContent:
Set the margin at the bottom of all elements of the post class by typing margin-bottom.

Make sure to type margin-bottom.

lessons.title: Example 4
lessons.interactiveContent:
Set the margins on all four sides of all img elements by typing margin: 5px;.

Make sure to type margin: 5px;.
